3.t: And Him Who hath created male and female,

4.t: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).

5.t: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)

7.t: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.

8.t: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,

10.t: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.

11.t: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.

12.t: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance

13.t: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.

14.t: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire

15.t: Which only the most wretched must endure,

16.t: He who denieth and turneth away.

17.t: Far removed from it will be the righteous

18.t: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).

19.t: And none hath with him any favour for reward,

20.t: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
